name: Remora
tagline: the drafter: ride the wake, latch, sling past
summary: The drafter. Alone it is slow (55 u/s). In a rival's wake its speed cap becomes their speed ×1.3, so it catches anyone it can get behind. Hold LT within reach behind a rival and it latches: towed at their speed, the draft meter filling, taking petals if its Mass is up. Let go, or press RT, and it slings past at ×1.7 their speed plus the draft. Never leads until the last straight.

spec.v: wake draft · LT latch (towed) · release to sling
cap = rival speed ×1.3 within 14 u of their path
racing's draft and slipstream: Mario Kart World, F-Zero, Rocket League boost chains

fantasy: The fish that rides the shark. It makes every race a two-hander: pick your host, hide in their wake, and the last corner is yours.
why: In racing, winners add new skill verbs rather than tracks (Mario Kart World 14M on grind and wall-ride; CrossWorlds at 84 Metacritic still missed). Drafting is racing's oldest tactic and no Cosmic Shore hull owns it. It is also the purest PvP-is-petals-only vessel: its only attack is a tow that drinks petals.

charge.name: Sling
charge.tip: Charge is the energy of the sling off a host.

mass.name: Leech
mass.tip: Mass is how many petals a tow takes per second (0 at level 0; PvP is petals only).

space.name: Latch Reach
space.tip: Space is how far behind a rival LT can latch.

time.name: Deep Draft
time.tip: Time is how much faster than its host a drafting Remora may go.

styles.name: Balanced
styles.info: Every element at 0: the recipe's numbers.

styles.name: Shadow
styles.info: Latches from far and drafts deep: never loses its host.

styles.name: Parasite
styles.info: Drinks petals while towed and slings hardest: the hunter.

styles.name: Maxed
styles.info: Every element at 10. A ceiling, not a match state.

notModelled: Its rivals here are other Remoras; in the game it would draft any hull, and a Manta at 720 u/s is a very different host.
A wake is a 4 s path of 0.1 s samples; the game would need a wake volume per vessel.
Alone on a course it is the slowest hull in the fleet by design: race it with players.
sources: Design: Docs/Studios/CONCEPT_FLEET.md (Remora). Petal transfer follows Docs/ELEMENTAL_ECONOMY.md (a debuff is a transfer); the Squirrel's Crystal Joust is the nearest shipped relative.

scorecard.note: Headless races seat two Hard rivals (Ruby, Gold): the Remora has nothing to draft alone.
